title: Perfect matching with edge assignment
statement: For natural numbers $q$, $k$, and $n$, a perfect matching with edge assignment consists of a perfect matching in the complete multipartite graph with $q$ parts of size $k$, together with an assignment of an $n$-valued label to each edge of that matching.
hypotheses_covered: Natural numbers q, k, and n
